_comment: Shrink-only ceiling for scripts/verify-diesel-expense-fuel-dedupe.mjs. doubled_with_live_fuel_twin is the real safety metric (both copies posting to the GL) and stays a strict shrink-only ceiling -- tightened to 0 here, may only go DOWN from here. live_diesel_expenses was RAISED, not shrunk, 2026-09-22 (172) and again 2026-09-25 (172->190): an architecture change (fuel now correctly flows through accounting.expenses as Diesel-typed documents as part of normal ingestion, not as accidental duplicates) makes this count legitimately grow going forward. 2026-09-25 raise confirmed live before raising: of the live population (190, USMCA, voided_at IS NULL, memo ILIKE 'Diesel%'), ALL 190 have source_fuel_transaction_id IS NOT NULL (correctly fuel-engine-created via createExpenseFromFuelTransaction), 0 are the forbidden kind (a regular expense miscategorized as diesel); doubled_with_live_fuel_twin independently re-measured 0. Growth = AUTH-032's 57 re-dated fuel purchases plus ordinary Faro-feed growth since the 2026-09-22 baseline. Re-tighten live_diesel_expenses only after a real audit decides which rows are true legacy duplicates vs correct new-architecture rows -- that decision is out of scope for this baseline bump. This raise only, never doubled_with_live_fuel_twin -- same precedent as the 2026-09-22 raise.
